# watchpoint_status_page_subscriber (Resource)

A status page subscriber that is a system rather than a person: a signed webhook, or a Slack or Microsoft Teams channel. Incident and maintenance updates are delivered to it. Admin-added subscribers are confirmed immediately. Every attribute replaces the subscriber when changed. Requires the `status_pages` and `incident_management` features.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Post incident and maintenance updates for two components into a Slack channel.
resource "watchpoint_status_page_subscriber" "eng_slack" {
  status_page_id = watchpoint_status_page.public.id
  channel        = "Slack"
  url            = var.status_slack_webhook_url
  component_ids  = [watchpoint_status_page_component.api.id, watchpoint_status_page_component.web.id]
}

# A signed webhook; verify deliveries with the secret returned on create.
resource "watchpoint_status_page_subscriber" "partner_hook" {
  status_page_id = watchpoint_status_page.public.id
  channel        = "Webhook"
  url            = "https://partner.example.com/status-events"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel` (String) `Webhook`, `Slack` or `Teams`.
- `status_page_id` (String) Status page to subscribe to.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) HTTPS endpoint. Slack URLs must be on `hooks.slack.com`; Teams URLs on `*.webhook.office.com`, `*.logic.azure.com` or `*.powerplatform.com`. Chat URLs carry a token and are returned masked, so the configured value is kept in state.

### Optional

- `component_ids` (Set of String) Only notify for these components (Slack and Teams only). Omit for every component.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Subscriber ID.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) HMAC secret for verifying webhook deliveries (`Webhook` only). Returned once at creation and not recoverable by import.
- `status` (String) Subscriber status, `Confirmed` for an admin-added subscriber.
